name: pe3-checkui
prompt:
Kreative Studio (plain browser JavaScript, classic <script>, no modules, no libraries). Write public/js/pose-check.js for STU-PE3: the "Check a picture" part of the Pose tab. Return the whole file. Do not change the test file (test/e2e/check.e2e.js) or index.html.

The whole file is one IIFE: (function () { 'use strict'; ... })(); Run setup() on DOMContentLoaded (or at once when document.readyState is not 'loading').
Look up KKPoseEditor lazily when used (window.KKPoseEditor is set by another file on DOMContentLoaded): const stage = () => window.KKPoseEditor.stage; stage().getPose(), stage().getView() -> {yaw, pitch, width, height}, stage().apply(ops) (applies a list of PE1 ops with undo, throws on a bad op). KKPose.draw.drawOpenPose(img, kp) draws an OpenPose skeleton into img = KKPose.raster.create(w, h) ({width, height, data RGBA}); KKPose.posecheck.fromOpenPose(json) -> kp.

Elements (ids): check-file (input file), check-tol (range 5..45) and check-tol-val (output: value + '°'), check-run, check-apply, check-mask (buttons, disabled at start), check-overlay (canvas 512x768, hidden at start), check-summary (p), check-bones (ul), error-msg-check (div).

LABELS = {torso: 'Torso', head: 'Head', l_upper_arm: 'Left upper arm', l_forearm: 'Left forearm', r_upper_arm: 'Right upper arm', r_forearm: 'Right forearm', l_thigh: 'Left thigh', l_shin: 'Left shin', r_thigh: 'Right thigh', r_shin: 'Right shin'}.

State: input = null ({keypoints} or {image: dataURL, bitmap: an ImageBitmap or HTMLImageElement}), last = null (the last API answer).

Behaviour:
- check-tol input: check-tol-val text = value + '°'.
- check-file change: clear the error, the list, the summary; disable apply and mask; hide the overlay. No file: input = null, disable run, return. A file whose name ends in .json or whose type is application/json: input = {keypoints: JSON.parse(await file.text())} (a parse error: show 'That file is not OpenPose JSON.' in error-msg-check, disable run, return). Otherwise read it as a data URL (FileReader.readAsDataURL) and load an Image from it: input = {image: dataURL, bitmap: img}. Enable check-run.
- run(): clear the error. body = {pose: stage().getPose(), view: {yaw, pitch} from stage().getView(), tol: Number(check-tol.value)} plus keypoints or image from input. r = await fetch('/api/pose/check', {method: 'POST', headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify(body)}); data = await r.json(). If !r.ok: show data.error (or 'Check failed (HTTP ' + r.status + ').') in error-msg-check, empty the list and summary, hide the overlay, disable apply and mask, return. Else last = data; render().
  check-run click calls run().
- render(): bones = last.check.bones. The list: one li per bone with dataset.bone = name, dataset.status = status and two spans: the label (LABELS) and the result: 'ok' -> err + '°', 'wrong' -> err + '° off', 'missing' -> 'not found', 'skip' -> 'not in the pose' (err printed with toFixed(0) unless it has a decimal part: use String(Math.round(err))). Summary: when last.pass: 'The picture matches the pose.'; else 'Off: ' + the labels of the wrong bones, largest err first, joined by ', ' + '.'. check-apply enabled when last.suggestion is not null; check-mask enabled when last.regions.length > 0. Then drawOverlay().
- drawOverlay(): canvas = check-overlay; W, H = last.detected.canvas_width and canvas_height; canvas.width = W, canvas.height = H; unhide it. ctx = canvas.getContext('2d'). Background: when input.bitmap, ctx.drawImage(input.bitmap, 0, 0, W, H); else fill with '#0c0917'. Then the target skeleton: img = KKPose.raster.create(W, H); KKPose.draw.drawOpenPose(img, KKPose.posecheck.fromOpenPose(last.target)); copy it onto the canvas so only drawn (non-black) pixels show, at 70% alpha (build an ImageData where black pixels get alpha 0 and others 179, putImageData on an offscreen canvas, then ctx.drawImage it). Then each region box [x1, y1, x2, y2]: ctx.strokeStyle = '#f3941f', ctx.lineWidth = 3, ctx.setLineDash([8, 6]), strokeRect(x1, y1, x2 - x1, y2 - y1).
- check-apply click: if last && last.suggestion: try stage().apply(last.suggestion.ops) (an error goes to error-msg-check); then run() again.
- check-mask click: W, H as above; an offscreen canvas W x H filled black, each region box filled white; canvas.toBlob -> download as 'pose-check-mask.png' (an <a download> with an object URL, appended, clicked, removed, URL revoked).

Never use innerHTML with data; build elements with document.createElement and textContent.
